headline.title: OpenAI Campus Network: Student club interest form
headline.summary: OpenAI has launched the Campus Network, aimed at connecting student clubs globally to facilitate access to AI tools, event hosting, and the development of an AI-focused campus community. Interested students can fill out an interest form to participate in the initiative.

articles.title: The new AI-powered Google Finance is expanding to Europe.
articles.summary: Google Finance is launching its AI-powered features in Europe, enhancing user experience with advanced analytics and insights. This expansion aims to provide European users with improved financial data management and investment tools.

articles.title: How enterprises are scaling AI
articles.summary: Enterprises are advancing their AI initiatives by transitioning from initial experiments to broader implementations that emphasize trust, governance, workflow design, and quality. This strategic approach aims to enhance the overall impact of AI across organizations.

articles.title: I Work in Hollywood. Everyone Who Used to Make TV Is Now Secretly Training AI
articles.summary: In Hollywood, screenwriters and other creatives are increasingly turning to AI-related gig work as traditional job opportunities diminish. One writer reports completing 20 contracts for various platforms in just eight months, highlighting the challenging landscape for those in the industry.

articles.title: CUDA Proves Nvidia Is a Software Company
articles.summary: Nvidia's success is increasingly attributed to its software capabilities, particularly through its CUDA platform, which has created a significant competitive advantage. This shift highlights the importance of software in the company's overall strategy, reinforcing its position as a leading player in the AI and computing sectors.

articles.title: 2.5-D Decomposition for LLM-Based Spatial Construction
articles.summary: A new study introduces a neuro-symbolic pipeline utilizing 2.5-D decomposition to enhance spatial reasoning in autonomous systems that construct structures from natural language instructions. This approach allows large language models to plan in two dimensions while a deterministic executor handles vertical placements, addressing systematic coordinate errors in three-dimensional block arrangements.

articles.title: MPD$^2$-Router: Mask-aware Multi-expert Prior-regularized Dual-head Deferral Router in Glaucoma Screening and Diagnosis
articles.summary: The MPD$^2$-Router is a novel framework designed for glaucoma screening that utilizes a mask-aware, multi-expert approach to improve the routing of difficult cases to human specialists. This method addresses challenges such as expert availability, reader behavior variability, and workload imbalances in the diagnostic process.

articles.title: Domain-level metacognitive monitoring in frontier LLMs: A 33-model atlas
articles.summary: A study analyzed metacognitive monitoring across 33 frontier large language models (LLMs) using 1,500 items from the MMLU benchmark, revealing significant domain-level variation in performance despite overall aggregate scores. The research highlights the importance of examining within-model differences to better understand LLM capabilities across specific domains.

articles.title: From Specification to Deployment: Empirical Evidence from a W3C VC + DID Trust Infrastructure for Autonomous Agents
articles.summary: The article discusses the implementation of a W3C Verifiable Credentials (VC) and Decentralized Identifiers (DID) trust infrastructure to support autonomous AI agents, which are currently executing a significant volume of transactions without a shared trust layer. It highlights the convergence of regulatory frameworks and major AI laboratories on the need for an open and cryptographically verifiable system to enhance trust in these transactions.

articles.title: R$^3$L: Reasoning 3D Layouts from Relative Spatial Relations
articles.summary: The paper introduces R$^3$L, a framework designed to enhance the reliability and consistency of reasoning about 3D layouts using relative spatial relations. It addresses the limitations of current methods that rely on Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for inferring these relations, which often result in unreliable outputs.

articles.title: PAMPOS: Causal Transformer-based Trajectory Prediction for Attack-Agnostic Misbehavior Detection in V2X Networks
articles.summary: The article introduces PAMPOS, a causal transformer-based model designed for trajectory prediction in Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) networks, aimed at detecting misbehavior without relying on labeled attack samples. This approach addresses the limitations of existing supervised misbehavior detection schemes, enhancing resilience against unseen insider falsification attacks.

articles.title: Knowledge Transfer Scaling Laws for 3D Medical Imaging
articles.summary: Researchers have explored knowledge transfer scaling laws for 3D medical imaging, focusing on the unified pretraining of vision foundation models across various imaging modalities like CT, MRI, and PET. The study highlights the challenges of mixing heterogeneous imaging domains and critiques existing heuristic strategies for model training.
